Name: Guild Sells Dwarf Scrolls
Author: Preachie
Description:
A simple mod that allows players to purchase dwarf scrolls from the Adventurer's Guild. [i](Who knows why they have these)


[/i][b]How it works?
[/b]
- You can purchase them from Marlon after you've reached [b]Floor 120[/b] in [b]The Mines. [/b][i](Which basically means you've reached the end of The Mines.)
[/i]- These costs 15,000 G
- Can only be sold once per day. [i](Scrolls are random)


[/i]You can now have all the scrolls with having to pray to the RNG gods.

[b][size=4]My Other Mod:[/size]
[/b]- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22347]Purchaseable Jellies[/url][/b]
